steps.title: SRO Deed Registration & Stamp Duty Verification
steps.description: Registered Sale Deed No 4122/2025 verified by SRO Haveli. Ready Reckoner valuation ₹87,00,000, 6% Stamp Duty (₹5,22,000) & 1% Reg Fee verified.

steps.title: Pencil Entry (कच्ची नोंद) in Form 6 Register
steps.description: Talathi recorded provisional pencil entry No 101 in Village Chavadi register (गाव नमुना ६).

steps.title: Talathi Physical Ground Visit & GPS Photo Panchnama
steps.description: Talathi visited Gat 42, took 4 geo-tagged site photographs with live GPS (18.5793°N, 73.9812°E), verified boundary pegs (शेव), and recorded panchnama with adjoining landholders.

steps.title: Form 135D Statutory Public Notice Issued
steps.description: 15-day statutory objection notice served to all recorded co-sharers, adjoining owners, and Gram Panchayat notice board.

steps.title: Objection Window Period Ended (Zero Objections)
steps.description: Zero objections received during the mandatory 15-day statutory window. Talathi submitted formal recommendation dossier.

steps.title: Tehsildar Statutory Sanction Order (Class-3 DSC)
steps.description: Tehsildar Sanjay Deshmukh verified deed, Talathi report, and title audit. Signed statutory order using Class-3 DSC USB token.

steps.title: MahaBhulekh 7/12 RoR & 8A Extract Finalized
steps.description: Pencil entry converted into permanent record (पक्की नोंद). Digital 7/12 RoR updated and pushed to Citizen DigiLocker.

steps.title: SRO Release Deed Registration & Stamp Duty Paid
steps.description: Registered Release Deed submitted by Suresh Chavan at SRO Haveli. Article 52 family release stamp duty ₹500 verified.

steps.title: Pencil Entry Form 6 Generated
steps.description: Provisional entry No 182 created in e-Ferfar register by Talathi Lohegaon.

steps.title: Talathi Field Inspection & Boundary Verification
steps.description: Talathi conducted ground visit, took geotagged parcel photos, and verified co-parcener consent.

steps.title: Notice Period Form 135D Active
steps.description: Notice active. 15 days statutory objection window expires on 2025-03-04.

steps.title: Tehsildar Hearing & Sanction Order
steps.description: Awaiting completion of statutory notice window before DSC sanction.
